title: Driver Help: Filing the Wayfare Repair Schedule Estimate on a Cleaning and Damage Fees Report
content:
Applies to receipt-based Cleaning and Damage Fees damage reports under review — Damage Fee (Interior Repair) and Damage Fee (Exterior Repair).

For a receipt-based damage report under review, the Wayfare repair schedule estimate is the repair amount the Wayfare repair schedule gives for the level held; when the shop estimate on file is more than the schedule tolerance above the schedule estimate, the driver files the schedule estimate as a second repair estimate, its amount replaces the shop estimate's amount as the repair amount on file, and both estimates stay on the evidence ledger.

## What the filing changes

| Before the filing | After the filing |
|---|---|
| one repair estimate submission (the shop estimate) on the evidence ledger | two repair estimate submissions: the shop estimate and the schedule estimate |
| repair amount on file is the shop estimate's amount | repair amount on file is the schedule estimate amount |

The filing is recorded on the report's evidence ledger as one repair estimate submission at the fee level the report holds, dated the day it is filed.

## Hand-over card: `file_schedule_repair_estimate_16065485`

**Capability.** The driver files the Wayfare repair schedule estimate for the damage on their own report from the driver app. The filing is recorded on the report's evidence ledger as one repair estimate submission at the fee level the report holds, dated now, and the repair amount on file for the report becomes the schedule estimate amount, replacing the amount of any earlier estimate. The driver sees the estimate on the report and the new repair amount on file.

**How it is invoked.** This is the driver's own tool. The agent unlocks `file_schedule_repair_estimate_16065485` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the driver who made the report — runs it from the driver app.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the driver's damage report (the cleaning or damage fee assessment) the estimate is filed on, as given to the driver by support from the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `schedule_estimate_amount` | the schedule estimate amount being filed | US dollars as a decimal number rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 486.25 |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("estimate_filed" once the filing is on record), `damage_event_id` (the reference number of the new estimate submission entry), `damage_assessment_id` (the report reference number) and `repair_amount_on_file` (the repair amount now on file, US dollars with 2 decimal places).
